user.title: Connect to TriTue YouTube Player
user.description: Connect to the Home Assistant App or standalone Docker container.

data_description.url: Use the suggested internal URL for the App, or http://IP:8099 for Docker.
data_description.token: Copy the security token from the player startup log. This is not a license key.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the player server.
error.invalid_url: Enter the player's HTTP or HTTPS URL (a path such as /yt is allowed), without a query.
error.unsupported_api: The player server uses an unsupported API version.
error.unknown: The player returned an unexpected response.

abort.already_configured: This player server is already configured.

init.title: Playback output
init.description: Choose the physical media_player that will receive songs selected from this integration. Google Cast entities use the official YouTube Cast app.

invalid_target.message: The YouTube URL or identifier is not supported.

communication_error.message: The player server did not accept the command.

search_error.message: YouTube Music search is temporarily unavailable.

entry_unavailable.message: The selected TriTue player server is not loaded.

invalid_target_entities.message: Select between 1 and 16 physical media players.

playback_error.message: The source could not prepare this item for playback.

target_unavailable.message: The selected playback entity is unavailable. Open Configure and choose another media_player.

invalid_target_entity.message: The integration's virtual player cannot be selected as its own output.

cast_playlist_requires_video.message: Google Cast needs a playlist URL containing both v=VIDEO_ID and list=PLAYLIST_ID.

target_source_unsupported.message: This device cannot play a YouTube page as audio. Choose an Android TV/display Cast entity, or use a direct audio source for speakers.

session_not_found.message: That playback session has already ended.

queue_end.message: There is no next or previous song in this session's queue.

play_on_players.name: Play on selected media players
play_on_players.description: Resolve YouTube, public Zing or direct HTTP audio and play it on one or more media players as one session.

entry_id.description: Config entry ID of the TriTue player server.

target.name: Media target
target.description: YouTube video ID or URL, or a Zing song URL returned by search.

entity_id.name: Speakers and displays
entity_id.description: Physical media players that receive the media.

media_content_type.name: HTTP media type
media_content_type.description: Optional MIME type for direct HTTP audio.

session_id.name: Session
session_id.description: Keep playing in this session (and its queue).

join.name: Join session
join.description: Add these players to the session without restarting its other players.

skip.name: Next or previous song
skip.description: Play the next or previous song of a session's queue on its speakers.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Config entry ID of the TriTue player server.

session_id.name: Session
session_id.description: Session to skip; the latest one when empty.

stop_session.name: Stop session
stop_session.description: Stop a session's speakers and end the session.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Config entry ID of the TriTue player server.

session_id.name: Session
session_id.description: Session to stop; everything when empty.

remove_players.name: Remove players from sessions
remove_players.description: Stop these players and take them out of their sessions; other players keep playing.

entry_id.description: Config entry ID of the TriTue player server.
